entities.summary: Simon Segal was a French figurative painter and member of the School of Paris. Born in the Russian Empire he emigrated to France in 1925 and was naturalized in 1949. He painted portraits, animals, landscapes and seascapes and created illustrations and mosaics. His scarce work is characterized by an austere but expressive style epitomized by his works from La Hague (1946–1953).
